title: Manipulation Testing in Boundary Discontinuity Designs
abstract: arXiv:2609.00350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose the first manipulation test designed for boundary discontinuity designs (BDDs) with general boundary shapes. A BDD is a multidimensional extension of the regression discontinuity design (RDD) in which treatment assignment is determined by whether the multidimensional running variable crosses a lower-dimensional boundary set. The test avoids multivariate density estimation and builds on the observation that, in the absence of manipulation, observations near the boundary should be approximately evenly split between treatment and control within arbitrary groups defined by their projections onto the boundary. We test this implication using a collection of binomial balance tests on observations near the boundary, with groups formed by k-means clustering. translated_title: 具有一般边界形状的边界断点设计中的操纵检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了首个专为具有一般边界形状的边界断点设计（BDD）设计的操纵检验方法。BDD是回归断点设计（RDD）的多维扩展，其中处理分配由多维运行变量是否越过低维边界集合决定。该检验避免了多元密度估计，并基于如下观察：在不存在操纵的情况下，边界附近的观测值在由其向边界投影所定义的任意分组内，应在处理组与对照组之间近似均匀分布。我们通过对边界附近观测值进行一系列二项式平衡检验来检验这一含义，其中分组由k均值聚类形成。我们在适当的正则性条件下建立了该检验的渐近有效性。我们还通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估了该检验的有限样本表现，并说明了（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了首个适用于一般边界形状的边界断点设计（BDD）的操纵检验方法，该方法利用k均值聚类对边界附近观测值分组并进行二项式平衡检验，从而避免了多元密度估计，并证明了其渐近有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first manipulation test for boundary discontinuity designs (BDDs) with general boundary shapes, which avoids multivariate density estimation by conducting binomial balance tests on boundary-adjacent observations grouped via k-means clustering, and establishes its asymptotic validity.
